text:
The change set is not ready to launch. Two controller tests that pass on the committed baseline (81/81) now fail with your changes (79 of 81 pass). I did not edit any file.

- **Blocking: reopen attempts.** `reopen_max_attempts` went from 2 to 5. `test_reopen_attempts_are_bounded_per_domain_and_temperature` and `test_resumed_state_keeps_reopen_attempt_budget` fail, because they depend on the old default. Your edit to `test_default_config_leaves_reopen_off` replaced the exact value check with `>= 1`, so that test no longer pins the value. The CLI has no `--reopen-max-attempts` flag, so any run with `--reopen-enclosing-domain` would silently get 5 attempts instead of 2.
- **Blocking: nucleation fraction.** `ControllerConfig.nucleation_fraction` went from 0.5 to 0.35, but the campaign CLI always passes its own `--nucleation-fraction` (default 0.5) at `scripts/run_design_controller.py:1038`. A campaign launched from the CLI will therefore still run at 0.5, which is probably not what you intend. Other callers that don't pass the value, such as `scripts/run_hairpin_controller.py`, now silently get 0.35. `AGENTS.md` says helper defaults are part of the method. Nothing in `SOL_EXECUTION_PLAN.md` or the status files mentions 0.35, so the change is undeclared, and no test covers it.
- **Minor:** The adaptive-coupled-release check on `trap_release_steps == 0` was removed from the CLI. `ControllerConfig` (`controller.py:222`) enforces the same rule, so it still fails, only later and with the same message. I did not check whether any setup runs between the two points.
- **Minor:** The edits to the `--eligibility-mode` help text and the "positive integer" error message change wording only. They have no effect on behavior.

Before launch, pick one of two routes for each default (2→5 and 0.5→0.35). Either revert it, or declare it in the plan with a CLI flag and a test that pins the new value. I did not run any MD, and I did not review whether 0.35 or 5 is scientifically sound.
